name: Vi
description: Voice set for Primal Ambush Vi (skin 39): the unfazed leader of a clan of beast-warriors, strongest in the land, hungry for any challenger worthy of her fists. Hunts, trails, claws, the pride and the den. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. The prey's slipping away. Call the pride.
Thirty or more behind. Roar. Let the whole forest hear.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Send word down every trail you know.
Fifteen-odd short. A scratch, not a mauling.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring a packmate. Even I hunt better with company. Sometimes.
{voteDiff} behind. A few clean swipes and we're level.
Down {voteDiff}. Tiny gap. Close it before dusk.
Dead level. One claw-mark tips it. Make it.
One vote apart. Stop crouching in the brush and pounce.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Hackles up. Gather more claws.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This one lasts till nightfall.
{momentTitle} is prowling at {userPct}%. That's an apex move.
{userPct}% and still stalking. Don't let the grass grow under you.
{userPct}%. Strong stance. Stay low.
{userPct}% on your pick. We hold the clearing. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good hunting. Now finish it.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. A pounce from nowhere.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The ambush landed.
Clawed out of a {voteDiff} pit. Even the birds went quiet.
{momentTitle} was getting hunted. Now it's the hunter.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Nobody saw it crouch.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two predators, one trail.
{username} picked {momentTitle} too. Same scent, same hunt.
{username} agrees with you. Mark the day. Rare.
Same pick as {username}. Keen nose.
{username} marked {momentTitle}. Good instincts.
{username} chose the same. They run with the pride now.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Leave them a spot by the fire.
{username} made the same call. No growling needed.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the pack.
{username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Different prey. Let's see who eats.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Following the wrong scent.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but fearless.
{username} voted against you. Challenger. Good. I was getting bored.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Bold. Foolish. Bold.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Meet me in the clearing.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. The count settles it.
{username} voted the other way. They'll come limping soon.
details: Every hunter chases the wrong trail once.
Don't take it personally. Or growl about it.
A rival keeps the claws sharp.
At least it's a fair fight.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's a shared scent.
{username} and you, ten matches, same trail every time. Perfect hunting pair.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd stalk beside you two anywhere.
A ten-match run with {username}. Silent and deadly.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. I'm not smiling. Fangs, maybe.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's past a pair, that's a whole pride.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you two into any thicket.
{streakCount} matching picks with {username}. Ridiculous. Gloriously so.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. They'll tell cubs about this.
{streakCount} with {username}. Alpha status. Both of you.
details: Hard to believe. Earned in blood and sweat.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. That's a territory dispute now.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They really don't like your scent.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will leave the clearing.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn beasts, both.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd stay and watch the whole fight.
details: Talk it out. Or wrestle it out.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a war over the forest.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up a paw of ground.
{streakCount} clashes in a row with {username}. Stubborn is too soft a word.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone fetch the elders.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Rest in the sun for a bit.
details: Neither of you gives an inch of turf.
Even the old tales are shorter.

messages: {matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft} and you haven't made your mark. Stalk closer.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. No claw-mark from you. Fix it.
{matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft}. Your swipe is the missing one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Sprint, don't stroll.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me carry you by the scruff.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. The forest's gone quiet around you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last light of the hunt.
{timeLeft} left. Pounce.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Strike.
{matchCount} matches without your mark are about to close. The first ends in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and dusk is falling. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody leap first. Don't hover.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single swipe. I'll wait. Barely.
New match, zero votes. Be the first paw in the clearing.
{matchTitle} is untouched. Take the first bite.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A sparse pride.
Hardly a track in the mud. Leave some.
Turnout's thin. Come on, bring the clan.
No claw-marks on this one. Someone should leave some.
details: Every mark counts in an empty forest.
Don't let the trail go cold.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Pick your prey.
Dead even on {matchTitle}. One swipe decides it.
Tied. Someone has to lunge. Be someone.
{moment1} and {moment2}, circling each other. Choose.
Still tied and the sun's almost down. One chance to strike.
Level with the light fading. Vote.
Tied, and nightfall's near. Don't sit this one out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new trails to follow. Go.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. The hunt begins.
Round {round} has begun, with {matchCount} quarries.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your prey.
Round {round}: {matchCount} trails waiting on you.
{momentTitle} won. A clean takedown.
{momentTitle} is through. Roar for it.
{momentTitle} took the hunt. Deserved.
{momentTitle} won, and the whole forest felt it.
{momentTitle} advances. Smooth stalk.
{momentTitle} moves on. Fangs bared.
{momentTitle} lost. That one drew blood.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the hunt we planned.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Lick your wounds.
{momentTitle} went down snarling. Respect.
{momentTitle} is out. Retreat to the den and reset.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Bruised. Not beaten.
{momentTitle} got driven off. We pick up another trail.
details: Not every hunt ends in a catch.
It put up a good fight.

messages: Still deciding? Quit circling and strike.
Don't overthink it. Pick and pounce.
They're all worth stalking. Trust your nose.
You've watched from the grass long enough. Move.
details: No wrong trail. A few dead ends.

messages: Welcome to the hunting grounds. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New cub? {liveCount} matches are live. Follow me.
You're early. {liveCount} matches need claws.
{liveCount} matches open. Choose your trail.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Keep your tail down.
Day two. You came back. Good instincts.
Two days running. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. Did the trail go cold?
After {days} days you're back. Better late than lost.
{days} days. Thought you'd wandered off. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. The forest changed.
You came back. Good.
Welcome back. Let's hunt.
Back already. Hungry?
Hey. The trail's still fresh.
First mark made. Welcome to the hunt.
You picked a side. First trail taken.
Five votes. Your claws are coming in.
Five. No longer a cub in the brush.
Ten votes. The pride knows your scent.
Ten. You belong in these woods.
details: A regular on every trail. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your roar carries.
Twenty-five. The whole canopy hears you.
Fifty votes. Deep in the thicket now.
Fifty. You actually care. Good beast.
A hundred votes. They'll tell tales of you around the fire.
One hundred. Honestly fearsome. Don't tell the others.
details: Earned in tooth and claw. +{xp} XP
A hundred. Bow your head. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A trail's forming.
Three straight days. Steady paws.
details: Three sunrises in the woods. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's real stamina.
Seven days running. Strong legs.
details: A week without losing the trail. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never rest.
Fourteen days. Whoa.
details: Two weeks, no missed dawn. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Honestly? Thank you. Truly.
A month in these woods. That means something.
details: A full month on the trail. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You track the ones the herd ignores.
Five unlikely catches. Good eye.
Fifteen underdogs. You follow the lone trails on purpose.
Fifteen. You don't follow the herd.
Thirty underdogs. Nobody can read your tracks.
Thirty. The outcast is your whole hunt.
details: Thirty marks for the one behind. +{xp} XP

messages: First to the clearing five times. Eager.
Five times you got there before the others.
details: You reach the kill zone first. +{xp} XP
Five marks before the herd arrives. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you led the charge. Brave.
First to move, again and again.
details: Fifteen marks before the rest. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole pack. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You thrive in a standoff.
Another tooth-and-claw finish. Your nerve is iron.
Twenty-five close matches. Your swipe keeps deciding the fight.
You've broken more than one stalemate.
You stuck with the underdog five times. Loyal. I approve.
You never abandon the one who's down. Respect.
details: Faith in a late pounce. +{xp} XP
Five comebacks you saw coming. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Somebody's got a favourite hunting ground.
That one again? Must taste good.
Five votes for the same moment. That's pride-loyal.
You won't let that one go. Fair.
Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, cub.
Ten times, same pick. I won't tell the elders. Much.
Two rounds. You're staying for the whole chase.
Round two and you're still hunting. Good.
details: Stay for the next trail. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. The woods are growing dark.
Deep in the bracket. Things bite harder from here.
Six rounds. You stayed till the last light.
All the way. You never left the chase.
details: First scent to final kill. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've sniffed out every glade.
Ten different matches. Thorough tracking. Nice.
Twenty-five matches. You've walked every ridge.
Twenty-five. Not a thicket unexplored.
Fifty matches. That's not a visit, that's a lifetime in the wild.
Fifty. You know this forest better than its elders.
Five in one sitting. A long chase.
Five back to back. Drink at the stream.
Ten in one go. Catch your breath.
Ten in one sitting. That's endurance.
Voting this late? Nocturnal or restless?
Middle of the night. Devotion, or you're hunting in the dark too.
You told others. Thanks, packmate.
Five shares. More hunters, more claws.
Fifteen shares. You're practically clan leader.
Fifteen. You keep gathering the pride. Love it.
You were here before the first hunt. Founding member, forever.
One of the first thousand. Nobody can claw that away.
details: That mark stays on you forever. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Hard-won.
Promoted. Don't preen.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. A fine trophy.
Another trophy for the den: {name}.
{rank}. Well earned.
You put in the miles and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Wild. Runs in the clan, sadly.
Ten long shots. You don't flinch.
details: Ten bets on the weaker beast. +{xp} XP
Long shots are your prey. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerve holds.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. I'm not purring.
A week beside Cait. She's taught you to wait in the grass.
A week and you never missed. Nice stalk.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Clean pounce.
Standoff, and you broke it. Respect.
details: The swipe that ended the hunt. +{xp} XP

messages: Vi's your champion now. Stay close to the pride.
Vi guards your flank. Don't make her growl at you.

upcoming: Not open yet. The hunt hasn't begun.
Voting hasn't started. I'll growl when it does.
prevote: Two moments, one mark. Study both before you decide.
Sniff them both out before you choose. No peeking at the herd.
I won't tell you which trail. Your hunt.
Go with your nose. It's usually right.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Make the first mark.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no mark from you. Move.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone around. First paw in the clearing.
Hardly a vote in and you leapt. Bold.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Nice. The hunt isn't over.
Ahead for now. Prey doubles back.
A lead's a lead. Stay low.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. My fur's standing up.
Razor-thin. One more swipe flips it. Call someone.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs a packmate.
voted-tied: Dead even. Nobody's winning the standoff.
A perfect tie. Maddening. Also kind of thrilling.
voted-behind: You're trailing. The trail may still be right.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite prey.
They lead. You're right where the lone wolves stand.
Down by {diff} points. Call your pack. Fill the woods.
The herd went elsewhere. Herds are often wrong.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Lick your wounds.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next trail.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a worthy quarry.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this hunt. More trails coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, strike first.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Every hunter's first strike is clumsy.
That's your first. It gets easier. I promise.
You're in the pride now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you roaming.
You keep returning to the den. Nice.
underdog: You chose the one the herd skipped. I saw.
A runt of a pick. Takes a thick hide to back that.
early: Early. You hit the glade before the herd.
Quiet woods so far. Your swipe echoes.
close: That swipe just shifted things. It's tight.
Razor-thin. One more claw flips it.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't dead. Bring the pride.
Not in front yet. Meaning more stalking.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't doze. Trails shift.
default: Heard. I'll keep my teeth to myself. For now.
Vote's in. Plenty more prey ahead.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no marks yet. Start with the quarry that makes your hackles rise.
Every trail's open. Pick. I won't rush you. Much.
{unvoted} left. No rush. Fine, some rush.
live-some: Good opening. The rest won't hunt themselves.
live-few: Close. Don't lose the scent now.
live-one: Last quarry. Don't let it get away.
One match between you and a full hunt.
live-closing: Some hunts end in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still lack your mark.
live-done: Every trail walked. Impressive. Go study the bracket.
Nothing left on your trail. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll return. Study the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. My tail's twitching as much as yours.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each move on. The rest limp home.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone survives the season.
Watch the standings. They shift fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are near. Two per group survive the cull.
No knockout yet. The groups must finish.
Wait. The knockout emerges when the groups close.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're driven out.
One loss ends it. No second pounces.
Every match bites harder now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round after round. One loss and you're prey.
Trace the lines. The herd thins each round.
Every line here is a quarry someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup complete. Thanks for hunting with me.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss the chase.
We have a champion. Worth every mile.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing's been marked out.
Empty. The territories haven't been drawn. Soon.
Bare ground for now. Return later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One swipe decides it. Choose.
Two quarries, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the hunt and tell me what you think.
voted: I took {pick} over {other}. Which scent do you follow?
{pick} gets my mark over {other}. Challenge me.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think I followed the wrong scent?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more claws.
I marked {pick} over {other} before most. Scratch yours beside it.
{pick} versus {other}, barely any votes yet. Yours would make a deep mark.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One swipe settles it.
{pick} and {other} are locked together. Your swipe splits them.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every mark counts now.
{voteDiff} votes divide {pick} and {other}. Leave your mark.
{voteDiff} separate {pick} and {other}. Either could take the kill.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few swipes flip it.
{pick} limps {voteDiff} behind {other}, still breathing. Feed it votes.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs the pride.
{voteDiff} down to {other}. {pick} is worth more than that. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's turn the hunt.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but barely. Help it hold ground.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not secure. Vote.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} with {pct}%. Come see what the fuss is.
{pick} holds {pct}%. {other} is far behind in the brush.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add your mark.
